Connects to Slack using Socket Mode and receives events, interactions, and slash commands.

This input connects to Slack using https://api.slack.com/apis/socket-mode[Socket Mode^]. Each message emitted from this input has a `type` metadata field that contains the event type: `events_api`, `interactive`, or `slash_commands`.
